notes: Each case: `response` is exactly what tciNextRate(request, receivedAt = <request now + 0.2 s>) returned, serialized with jsonlite::toJSON(auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = NA, null = 'null'), i.e. the body the Plumber router would send. `server.*` (package, version, commit, receivedAt, respondedAt, computeSeconds) is the generator's own clock and MUST NOT be compared.  `warnings` at the case level lists the response's warning codes for convenience.  All request numbers are stored with 15 significant digits and were fed to R exactly as stored (computed quantities were rounded to 15 digits before the call), so a port can replay `request` verbatim.  Error cases: `status`, `code`, `pointer`, `message` are the tci_api_error condition's fields; the HTTP body would be {apiVersion, requestId, errors: [{code, message, pointer}], server}. Base pump for every success case unless its request says otherwise: mL/hr, maxRate 1200, minRate 0.1, rateResolution 0.1, latency 1.5 s, interval 10 s; propofol 10 mg/mL to 3 mcg/mL effect, remifentanil 50 mcg/mL to 4 ng/mL effect; 70 kg 170 cm 50 y male.  The START of every clock is 2026-10-11T14:00:00.000Z.

errors.name: err_numeric_now
errors.notes: now as a JSON number (epoch seconds).
errors.message: /now must be an RFC 3339 string such as 2026-10-11T14:32:05.250Z; a JSON number is not accepted

errors.notes: a history event whose time is an epoch number.

errors.name: err_unit_token_mL_h
errors.notes: the message names the nearest accepted token (mL/hr).
errors.message: /pump/rateUnits: 'mL/h' is not an accepted unit token; the nearest accepted token is 'mL/hr' (accepted here: mL/hr, mg/hr, mg/min, mcg/hr, mcg/min, mg/kg/hr, mg/kg/min, mcg/kg/hr, mcg/kg/min)

errors.name: err_unit_micro_sign
errors.notes: bolus units written with U+00B5 MICRO SIGN; the nearest token named is mcg.
errors.message: /history/0/units: 'µg' is not an accepted unit token; the nearest accepted token is 'mcg' (accepted here: mL, mg, mcg, mg/kg, mcg/kg)

errors.name: err_wrong_concentration_scale
errors.notes: ng/mL is a valid token but propofol is measured in mcg/mL.
errors.message: target.units must be mcg/mL for propofol

errors.name: err_latency_ge_interval
errors.message: timing.latency (10 s) must be less than timing.interval (10 s)

errors.name: err_two_rate_changes_same_instant
errors.message: two rate changes at the same instant (/history/0 and /history/1)

errors.name: err_event_5s_in_future
errors.notes: 5 s after now is beyond the 2 s clock-skew clamp.
errors.message: /history/0/time is 5.000 s after now; the history is the past, not a plan

errors.name: err_duplicate_json_key
errors.notes: The body must be fed to the parser as TEXT (requestText): JSON cannot carry a duplicate key in a parsed object, so `request` is null here.  A port must detect the duplicate while parsing (jsonlite keeps both keys; the server walks the parsed list).

errors.name: err_unknown_field
errors.message: unknown field 'foo' in the body; API version 1.0 accepts requestId, drug, now, patient, infusate, pump, target, timing, history, lookAhead, options
